title: The city across the water
summary: A calm river bending between green dykes and autumn-coloured reeds, with the office buildings of the city on the horizon under a grey sky.
content:
A calm river bending between green dykes and reeds in autumn colours, with the city on the horizon. The white dots on the water halfway are the geese of the next photo.

Sony RX10 V · f/8 · 1/13 s · ISO 64
